name: junglo
summary:
Junglo is a chaotic, physics-based fan game built for pure movement, loud laughs, and unpredictable moments. Inspired by the likes of Gorilla Tag, it throws you into uniquely designed maps where your hands are your legs, and every surface is a playground.

🏃‍♂️ No sticks. No buttons. Just movement.
Wall-run, bounce, climb, and vault your way across arenas with full-body locomotion. Whether you’re tagging others, running for your life, or showing off insane movement skills, every match feels different.

🎮
